history.content: idk why im even opening this lol
Hey, that’s okay — sometimes opening something is just opening something. What’s been on your mind, if anything?
nothing really. just stuff. my brain decided 11pm was a great time to replay a thing from like years ago, as it does
Yeah, that late-night replay can feel very “my brain, why now?” What kind of thing is it replaying — more awkward, sad, or just annoying?

annoying i guess?? like my old manager took credit for this whole project i basically built and i just smiled and said nothing. classic me. cool cool not still mad about it 2 years later or anything haha
That sounds really annoying — and maybe a bit like being brushed aside. What feels strongest in it now: the annoyance, the being credited over, or the “I said nothing” part?
the said nothing part probably. whatever. its done, cant change it. anyway thanks i should sleep
Yeah, that “said nothing” part seems to be the sharp bit. Sounds like it can rest here for now — sleep well.
